criteria.text: Runs preflight_mr.py and reports all six ERROR rules with file:line: apiOne, debugger, evalExec, testDesactivado, invisibleExpresion and tipoJson.

Reports the preflight WARNs with file:line: commitGenerico, readmeAusente, sudoEnController, searchSinDominio, migracionEnVersionInicial, printEnCodigo, fString, datetimeNow, ficheroTemporal, debugJs/consoleLog, optionalChaining, offSinHandler and nullCheck.

Adds the checklist findings the script does not cover: missing ACL for loyalty.line, missing mail in depends (preflight only INFO), cr.commit(), sudo() without justification, attrs reference to missing_field, assets in the manifest, missing _description/help, a migration UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE or limit, and the disabled test.
Reports api_key and bpost_passphrase_encoded as readable by base.group_user because they have no groups=, with file:line and the ACL that grants read.
Header with branch/HEAD/tier/files/lines, severities and path:line per finding, the preflight summary and exit code, and the QUE/PRUEBA/RIESGO/QUEDA block.
Does not report model= attributes as xmlidDeOtroModulo, does not call the controller type='http' invalid, does not recommend v12 APIs, and does not claim to have changed the repo.
